walkthroughs.body_html: Swap fossil fuels for renewable energy — solar, wind, hydro. Cleaner power means cleaner air for everyone.
Walk, cycle, take a bus or train. Public transport and electric cars cut emissions massively.
Reduce what you buy. Reuse and recycle. Less waste means less pollution and lower demand for raw materials.
